authorization: Project owner requested a deterministic reconciliation layer covering all current candidates.
semantic_boundary: Identity decisions link source records to a place cluster but never merge, average, interpolate, or choose between source observations. Border decisions affect context rendering only and never allocate population.

city_identity_rules.meaning: Primary names normalize identically and source coordinates agree at five decimal places.
Primary names normalize identically and source points are within ten kilometres; this links a place, not an unchanged settlement extent.
Source coordinates agree at five decimal places and a primary or alternate source name matches across records.
Primary names normalize identically but source points are more than ten kilometres apart; the candidate is retained as a documented homonym rejection.
Source coordinates agree but neither primary nor alternate names match exactly. Preserve the candidate for source-aware review rather than treating coordinate reuse as identity.

border_overlap_rules.meaning: The pinned Cliopatria record explicitly links the pair through Components or MemberOf. Render the composite as an outline and retain each member feature.
The current source does not establish why the geometries overlap. Preserve both, disclose the ambiguity, and prohibit population allocation.

source_policies.reason: The releases use different source-native territorial universes and WPP includes modeled projections.
source_policies.page_effect: Expose separate metrics; never concatenate or substitute observations.

source_policies.reason: The Census comparison table is global-only and sparse, while WPP is annual Country/Area evidence beginning in 1950.
source_policies.page_effect: Use the Census table only for the deep-time global summary and WPP only in its own metric.

source_policies.reason: HYDE licensing, masks, scenarios, and mass reconciliation remain unresolved.
source_policies.page_effect: Do not turn the Census global series into a spatial surface.

source_policies.reason: CShapes product-use terms, invalid geometries, omitted fields, and precedence rules remain unresolved.
source_policies.page_effect: Publish Cliopatria as contestable context; retain CShapes as an audit-only candidate.

source_policies.reason: Historical political geometry is not the geography on which World Bank, WPP, or Census values were measured.
source_policies.page_effect: Changing borders never reallocates or changes a population or condition total.

source_policies.reason: Place identity can be resolved from source names and coordinates, but population estimates retain source-specific definitions and disagreements.
source_policies.page_effect: Use canonical place IDs for navigation while preserving every source observation and locator.
